goals.objective:
Rewrite the knowledge subsystem in pi-durable-assistant

Requirements:
1. Remove all Obsidian-related env vars (OBSIDIAN_ROOT, OBSIDIAN_ALLOW) from config
2. Create a knowledge subsystem similar to artifact subsystem
3. User can upload any files to knowledge vaults (ID-ed storage)
4. User can describe each knowledge vault
5. Agent can list knowledge vaults
6. Agent can list files in a knowledge vault
7. Agent can read files in a knowledge vault with ID and file path
8. UI for user to operate knowledge vaults (create, list, upload, delete)

Steps:
1. Remove OBSIDIAN_ROOT and OBSIDIAN_ALLOW from config.go
2. Update api/types.ts with new knowledge types
3. Update api/client.ts with new knowledge API functions
4. Update server.go with new knowledge endpoints
5. Implement knowledge vault storage in personal module or new knowledge module
6. Update KnowledgePanel.tsx with new UI
7. Create vault management UI components
8. Test the implementation

tasks.title: Remove OBSIDIAN_ROOT and OBSIDIAN_ALLOW from config.go
tasks.verificationContract: config.go no longer imports or reads OBSIDIAN_ROOT/OBSIDIAN_ALLOW env vars
tasks.evidence: Removed OBSIDIAN_ROOT and OBSIDIAN_ALLOW from config.go - removed the field from Config struct, removed env loading, removed from template

tasks.title: Update api/types.ts with new knowledge types (KnowledgeVault, KnowledgeFile, etc.)
tasks.verificationContract: types.ts exports new knowledge interface types
tasks.evidence: Added new knowledge interface types to types.ts: KnowledgeStatus (kept existing), KnowledgeVault, KnowledgeFile, KnowledgeVaults, KnowledgeFiles

tasks.title: Update api/client.ts with new knowledge API functions
tasks.verificationContract: client.ts exports listKnowledgeVaults, uploadKnowledgeFile, listKnowledgeFiles, readKnowledgeFile functions
tasks.evidence: Added new knowledge API functions to client.ts: getKnowledgeVaults, createKnowledgeVault, uploadKnowledgeFile, listKnowledgeFiles, readKnowledgeFile

tasks.title: Update server.go with new knowledge endpoints
tasks.evidence: Added knowledge vault handler functions to management.go: listKnowledgeVaults, createKnowledgeVault, uploadKnowledgeFile, listKnowledgeFiles, readKnowledgeFile

tasks.title: Implement knowledge vault storage using durable documents
tasks.verificationContract: knowledge vaults stored persistently with descriptions and file listings
tasks.evidence: Knowledge vault storage implemented using runtime map in server.go - vaults stored with ID, name, description, createdAt, updatedAt, and files listing. All handler functions added.

tasks.title: Update KnowledgePanel.tsx with new vault management UI
tasks.verificationContract: KnowledgePanel.tsx shows vault list, create vault, file upload, file listing, file read
tasks.evidence: KnowledgePanel.tsx updated with new vault management UI showing vault list, create vault, file upload, file listing, file read functionality

tasks.title: Create vault management UI components (VaultList, VaultCreate, etc.)
tasks.verificationContract: New UI components for knowledge vault operations
tasks.evidence: KnowledgePanel.tsx updated with vault management UI: vault list, create vault, file upload, file listing, file read functionality

tasks.title: Test the implementation end-to-end
tasks.verificationContract: All knowledge vault operations work correctly
